add_sources.title: Crusoe touts 5 gigawatts of data centers, pauses Wyoming site

google-project-tembo.review_append: Same site as Crusoe/Tallgrass "Project Jade" (1.8 GW, announced Jul 2025): Crusoe paused and exited in Jun 2026 at Google's request (Bloomberg); Google continues with Black Hills. Not a separate project.
